rule.name: SpringProxySelfCall
rule.message: Move the annotated method to another bean and call it there. This call stays inside the class, so it skips the proxy and the called method''s annotation does nothing.

property.name: projectProxyAnnotations
property.description: Annotation types of the project that a proxy or aspect handles, found by nitpicker in the sources.

property.name: projectConstraintAnnotations
property.description: Bean Validation constraint annotations the project declares, found by nitpicker in the sources.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $proxyNames := ( 'org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional', 'org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Async', 'org.springframework.cache.annotation.Cacheable', 'org.springframework.cache.annotation.CachePut', 'org.springframework.cache.annotation.CacheEvict', 'org.springframework.cache.annotation.Caching', 'org.springframework.retry.annotation.Retryable', 'org.springframework.retry.annotation.CircuitBreaker', 'org.springframework.resilience.annotation.Retryable', 'org.springframework.resilience.annotation.ConcurrencyLimit', 'org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize', 'org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PostAuthorize', 'org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreFilter', 'org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PostFilter', 'org.springframework.security.access.annotation.Secured', 'jakarta.annotation.security.RolesAllowed', 'javax.annotation.security.RolesAllowed', 'jakarta.annotation.security.DenyAll', 'javax.annotation.security.DenyAll', 'io.github.resilience4j.retry.annotation.Retry', 'io.github.resilience4j.circuitbreaker.annotation.CircuitBreaker', 'io.github.resilience4j.ratelimiter.annotation.RateLimiter', 'io.github.resilience4j.bulkhead.annotation.Bulkhead', 'io.github.resilience4j.timelimiter.annotation.TimeLimiter', 'io.micrometer.core.annotation.Timed', 'io.micrometer.core.annotation.Counted', 'io.micrometer.observation.annotation.Observed', $projectProxyAnnotations), $constraintNames := ( for $name in ( 'AssertFalse', 'AssertTrue', 'DecimalMax', 'DecimalMin', 'Digits', 'Email', 'Future', 'FutureOrPresent', 'Max', 'Min', 'Negative', 'NegativeOrZero', 'NotBlank', 'NotEmpty', 'NotNull', 'Null', 'Past', 'PastOrPresent', 'Pattern', 'Positive', 'PositiveOrZero', 'Size') return ('jakarta.validation.constraints.' || $name, 'javax.validation.constraints.' || $name), for $name in ( 'CodePointLength', 'CreditCardNumber', 'Currency', 'EAN', 'ISBN', 'Length', 'LuhnCheck', 'Mod10Check', 'Mod11Check', 'Normalized', 'ParameterScriptAssert', 'Range', 'URL', 'UUID', 'ScriptAssert', 'UniqueElements') return 'org.hibernate.validator.constraints.' || $name, 'jakarta.validation.Valid', 'javax.validation.Valid', $projectConstraintAnnotations), $proxyAnnotation := function($annotation) { exists($annotation[some $name in $proxyNames satisfies pmd-java:typeIs($name)]) }, $typeOf := function($node) { $node/ancestor::*[self::ClassDeclaration or self::AnonymousClassDeclaration or self::EnumDeclaration or self::RecordDeclaration][1] }, $validated := function($method) { exists($typeOf($method)/self::ClassDeclaration/ModifierList/Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.validation.annotation.Validated')]) and exists($method[not(@Visibility = 'private' or pmd-java:modifiers() = 'static')]) and exists(($method[not(@Arity = 0 and matches(@Name, '^(get|is)\p{Lu}'))]/ModifierList/Annotation | $method/FormalParameters//Annotation)[ some $name in $constraintNames satisfies pmd-java:typeIs($name)]) }, $proxied := function($method, $callerTransactional) { exists($method/ModifierList/Annotation[$proxyAnnotation(.)] [not($callerTransactional and not(AnnotationMemberList) and pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional'))]) or $validated($method) }, $transactional := function($node) { exists($node/ancestor::MethodDeclaration[1]/ModifierList/Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional')]) } return ( //MethodCall[*[1][self::ArgumentList or self::TypeArguments or self::ThisExpression[not(*)]]][ let $name := @MethodName, $arity := count(ArgumentList/*), $callerTransactional := $transactional(.) return exists($typeOf(.)/self::ClassDeclaration/ClassBody/MethodDeclaration[@Name = $name] [@Arity = $arity or (@Varargs and $arity >= @Arity - 1)] [$proxied(., $callerTransactional)]) ] | //MethodReference[*[1][self::ThisExpression[not(*)]]][ let $name := @MethodName, $callerTransactional := $transactional(.) return exists($typeOf(.)/self::ClassDeclaration/ClassBody/MethodDeclaration[@Name = $name] [$proxied(., $callerTransactional)]) ] )
